source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Validation Data Set Preparation' under topic 6.8 (PDF 87, printed 83).

blocks.text: Validation dataset training aur testing data se alag hota hai aur model ki performance jaanchne ke liye istemal hota hai. Validation data saaf aur durust hona chahiye taake asal halaat ki numainda (sahi tasveer) ho. Model validation data se seekhta nahi. Validation overfitting pakarne mein madad deti hai aur jaanch behtar banati hai. Balanced data behtar results deta hai. Is qadam se model par bharosa barhta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Teen hisse yaad rakhein: training data se model seekhta hai; validation data se settings (hyperparameters) chuni jati hain aur overfitting dekhi jati hai; test data bilkul aakhir mein ek dafa asal performance batata hai. Aam taqseem 70% training, 15% validation aur 15% test hai (6.6 ki figure dekhein).

blocks.prompt: Validation data training data se alag kyun hona chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Agar model ko usi data par jaancha jaye jis se woh seekh chuka hai to woh sirf ratt kar achha score kar sakta hai. Alag validation data dikhata hai ke model naye cases kaise sambhalta hai, aur settings tune karte waqt overfitting pakarta hai.
